answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 73 identities per epoch. Audits are entered in canyon, queued in tundra, and terrace publishes the wait time. A farm of 225 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1449 identities would post 3948 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
